dashboard.condition.baidu_web: participates in engine/hybrid; usable as web fallback in baidu/apipool
dashboard.condition.bing: failure fallback in every mode; also a primary engine in engine/hybrid
dashboard.condition.proxy_engine: participates in engine/hybrid; requires a proxy resolver; connectivity not probed
dashboard.condition.github: participates in engine/hybrid; anonymous REST API tier without a key (search 10/min), 30/min with a PAT; reachable directly without a proxy; cleanfetch repo/blob pages reuse the same token
dashboard.condition.api_key: requires a configured key; participates in the matching single-source/hybrid or apipool.engines
dashboard.condition.anysearch: anonymous tier available without a key; participates in anysearch/hybrid or apipool.engines
dashboard.condition.api_key_hybrid: requires a configured key; participates in hybrid or apipool.engines
dashboard.condition.keenable: keyed tier when a key is configured; without a key set enabled: true explicitly or add it to apipool.engines (the public keyless tier is rate limited per IP and does not join hybrid automatically)

dashboard.suffix.yuanbao_cap: ; local monthly cap {{.Limit}} calls, calling stops once reached
